title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English, to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

A Mackay está buscando um Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) para o setor náutico, com experiência e proficiência em inglês, para trabalhar presencialmente em nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro. Candidatos com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo são encorajados a se candidatar.

RESUMO DA VAGA DE ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS NO BALCÃO (OTC)

O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades do Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) incluem, entre outras, a comunicação direta com nossos clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios.

As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO DE ESPECIALISTA EM ATENDIMENTO NO BALCÃO:

• Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.

• Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.

• Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.

• Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.

• Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.

• Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.

• Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.

• Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.

• Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE PRODUTOS DE BANCADA:

• Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.

• Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.

• Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.

• Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.

• Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.

QUALIFICAÇÕES PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE MEDICAMENTOS DE BANCADA:

• Dois anos de ensino superior.

• Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.

• Três anos de experiência em vendas internas ou no balcão.

• Bons conhecimentos de informática e internet.

• Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio.

Os candidatos devem estar autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil sem necessidade de patrocínio. A aprovação em uma verificação completa de antecedentes será exigida após a aceitação da oferta de emprego.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno
description:
Vaga exclusiva para mulheres (cis e trans). Candidaturas devem ser enviadas para , contendo carta de apresentação, + currículo. Não serão analisadas candidaturas enviadas por outros canais.



A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para coordenar nosso time administrativo-financeiro e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela é responsável pela coordenação e acompanhamento da equipe da área, pela elaboração de orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controle de fluxo de caixa e conciliação bancária. Além disso, desenvolverá processos integrados, que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, em um ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo. 


A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas negras, indígenas, pessoas vivendo com HIV/AIDS, pessoas LGBTI+ e com deficiência.


Quem somos

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos como ferramenta para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. As ações da organização são focadas em promover a redução dos estereótipos nocivos e da violência baseados no gênero. A Empodera trabalha com o desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

Principais responsabilidades


FINANCEIRO – OPERAÇÕES  (40%)  

  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa organizacional  
  • Supervisionar as operações financeiras diárias – contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber, salários, obrigações fiscais 
  • Analisar e apresentar relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunicar claramente as demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais; elaborar relatórios financeiros para prestação de contas e supervisionar a contabilidade financeira, de projetos/programas e doações  
  • Fornecer informações financeiras, conforme solicitado, e responder a consultas financeiras  
  • Supervisionar e liderar a elaboração do orçamento organizacional anual e planejamento financeiro em conjunto com a diretora executiva; monitorar progresso e mudanças; e manter a equipe de gestão a par do status financeiro da organização  
  • Supervisionar a  conciliação bancária de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
  • Fornecer atualizações sobre despesas por centro de custo/projeto, bem como outras informações financeiras em tempo hábil e preciso  
  • Priorizar e organizar ações e recursos para alcançar objetivos e contribuir para o desenvolvimento estratégico da Empodera.  
  • Gerenciar e monitorar o input das informações financeiras junto a um sistema integrado da organização 
  • Emitir notas fiscais de acordo com as obrigações legais e fiscais



FINANCEIRO – GESTÃO DE PROGRAMAS (15%)  

  • Manter comunicação frequente com as coordenadoras de projetos para análise dos gastos (reais x orçados)  
  • Apresentar a prestação de contas dos projetos nos prazos estipulados  
  • Fornecer relatórios financeiros mensais às coordenadoras de projetos, incluindo gastos por centro de custo / projeto, de maneira oportuna e precisa  
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de orçamentos para editais  
  • Garantir que a organização atenda aos requisitos externos dos doadores  
  • Comunicação com parceiros para transmitir informações sobre os programas, conforme apropriado.  


 FINANCEIRO – COMPLIANCE (10%)  

  • Atualizar e implementar todas as políticas e procedimentos financeiros necessários  
  • Coordenar e liderar eventuais processos de auditoria   
  • Supervisionar a produção do relatório financeiro anual   
  • Examinar documentos financeiros e legais para verificar a precisão e a aderência aos regulamentos e princípios financeiros aceitáveis  
  • Garantir o uso eficaz e transparente dos recursos financeiros, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empodera e organizações parceiras  


ADMINISTRATIVO – (15%)  

  • Coordenar as atividades administrativas da área/equipe 
  • Aprimorar/elaborar processos administrativos e políticas internas
  • Supervisionar os processos administrativos, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos adotados pela Empodera  
  • Orientar a equipe em relação aos procedimentos administrativos e financeiros  


RECURSOS HUMANOS E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (20%)  

  • Coordenar, acompanhar e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe
  • Garantir que folha de pagamento mensal, pagamento de benefícios e manutenção de registros das/os funcionárias/os sejam executados de maneira eficiente   
  • Garantir a conformidade com os regulamentos da legislação trabalhista local  
  • Participação em treinamentos internos e externos sobre temas relacionados à função e aos programas desenvolvidos pela organização. 



FORMAÇÃO, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS  


Formação:  Nível superior completo, com preferência para as áreas de ciências contábeis, administração, economia  


Conhecimentos e experiência:   

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas como Finanças, Controladoria, Gestão Estratégica ou Administração (será um diferencial)
  • Conhecimentos avançados do pacote office (particularmente excel) ou Google Workspace

  • Experiência comprovada no setor administrativo-financeiro em organizações da sociedade civil ((altamente desejável)   
  • Experiência com coordenação de equipes e de processos

description:

  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.

  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .

Assistência Médica

O FI Group busca um profissional da área Industrial para atuar como Consultor (a) Técnico Pleno – Químico/Industrial no Rio de Janeiro.


O Consultor (a) Técnico irá controlar e acompanhar carteira de clientes, realizando contatos telefônicos, por e-mail e visitas presenciais, analisando a elegibilidade dos projetos, avaliando as características técnicas, riscos, avanços tecnológicos em função de diretrizes, conforme manuais e procedimentos, a fim de classificar os projetos quanto a viabilidade do incentivo fiscal.

Como Consultor (a) Técnico, você irá:

  • Estudar a legislação, casos, serviços e produtos prestados pelo FI Group, através de leitura de guias internos, para obter conhecimento técnico e operacional, dentro dos procedimentos de consultoria, para condução da gestão de empresas categorizadas no mínimo com score C;
  • Efetuar alinhamento para mapear informações técnicas e os dispêndios envolvidos nos projetos, avaliando a tipologia e enquadramento, de acordo com o incentivo fiscal ou programa de fomento trabalhado, a fim de atribuir valor as atividades identificadas e calcular o benefício fiscal ou pleitear recursos para o cliente. De modo a garantir a rastreabilidade necessária perante os incentivos;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com foco nas áreas de conhecimento dos projetos, visando defender o conteúdo inovador e o enquadramento das atividades de PD&I na candidatura dos incentivos fiscais ou recursos para inovação Manter as ferramentas de gestão interna atualizadas, em tempo real, com informações referentes ao mapeamento da carteira de clientes, andamento dos produtos trabalhados e demais indicadores operacionais Seguir com analise critica da carteira;
  • Confeccionar e revisar dossiês econômicos, técnicos e finais para sua carteira de clientes, contendo balancetes e seus respectivos comprovativos econômicos, rastreabilidade contábil, relatórios, formulários e demais informações solicitadas pelos órgãos competentes. Assim como prestar suporte operacional e técnico aos outros consultores em todas as etapas do trabalho;
  • Realizar a apresentações junto aos clientes, com finalidades diversificadas, tais como início dos trabalhos, acompanhamento e finalização;
  • Participar de workshop e treinamentos internos para disseminação de conhecimentos e metodologias referentes aos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação, e externos para aculturamento a fim de identificar novas oportunidades dos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação. Realizar ações de relacionamento, visando fidelização da parceria.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação completa em: Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica e ou Química;
  • CNH ativa para dirigir;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Excel Intermediário/avançado;
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Cursos e Especializações na área de conhecimento;
  • Espanhol/Inglês;
  • Habilidades em escrita (elaboração de relatórios);
  • Formação adicional em TI.

O que oferecemos no FI Group:

  • Salário competitivo;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Gympass;
  • Day off de aniversário;

Muita possibilidade de crescimento! temos muito a crescer e esperamos fortemente que você nos ajude com isso!

“O FI Group valoriza a Diversidade e a Inclusão e por isso incentivamos à candidatura de todas as pessoas para nossas vagas independentemente de gênero, religião, etnia, idade, orientação afetivo sexual, ter deficiência, raça ou outro marcador identitário. Respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças.”

Ficou interessado(a)? Inscreva-se e conheça mais sobre nosso time. #VemSerFI

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

title: Tech Lead DevOps
description:
Vaga: Tech Lead DevOps Senior

Atuação: Híbrida 3x na semana na Barra da Tijuca/RJ

Projeto: Prazo indeterminado


A Mouts busca por um(a) Tech Lead DevOps Senior, para atuar de forma híbrida no Rio de Janeiro, que será responsável por:


• Projetar, implementar e evoluir infraestruturas cloud na plataforma Azure (AKS, VNET, Storage, ACR, Service Bus, Firewall etc.)

• Gerenciar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes com práticas avançadas de RBAC, Network Policies, Ingress, GitOps e Service Mesh

• Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código com Terraform (módulos reutilizáveis, state management, workspaces)

• Estruturar pipelines CI/CD maduros no Azure DevOps com estratégias blue/green, canary e quality gates (SonarQube)

• Implementar e manter estratégias de observabilidade com Azure Monitor, Grafana/Datadog e distributed tracing

• Garantir segurança de ambientes cloud e Kubernetes: Key Vault, Managed Identities, Zero Trust, scanning de imagens

• Apoiar práticas de FinOps: rightsizing, tagging strategy e monitoramento de custos via Azure Cost Management

• Participar ativamente de incident management, postmortems e definição de SLA/SLO/SLI


HABILIDADES E EXPERIÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS:

• Experiência com DevOps, Infraestrutura Cloud ou áreas correlatas

• Experiência sólida com Azure: AKS, VNET, ACR, EventGrid, Service Bus, Defender, Firewall, Application Gateway

• Kubernetes avançado: Helm, ArgoCD/Flux, OPA/Gatekeeper, Istio/Linkerd

• Redes: arquitetura Hub Spoke, DNS, VPN, Jumpserver, Conditional Forwards

• Terraform: módulos, remote backends, workspaces e boas práticas de IaC

• Containerização: Docker multi-stage builds, otimização de imagens, image promotion

• Disaster Recovery: backup strategies, geo-redundância, failover, RTO/RPO

• Scripting em Python e/ou Bash; administração Linux (networking tools, systemd, troubleshooting)


Se você gosta de desafios, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade!

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.


You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.


You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: AI Engineer
description:

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.

Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç
  • Eager to learn and keen on coaching and feedback;
  • Open to failure and rejection in the spirit of learning, progress, and resilienceç
  • Ability to demonstrate a level of success in executing a repeatable operation methodologyç
  • Must be self-motivated, persistent, and able to work independently.


WHAT MAKES THIS JOB A GREAT OPPORTUNITY

  • Build subject-matter expertise in an area of real estate operations and insurance that is lucrative and is undergoing serious digital transformation;
  • Fair compensation with pay raises and bonuses;
  • Mentorship from talented leaders;
  • Be part of an award-winning company that is tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month;
  • Be part of a lean and agile team, with a strong culture;
  • Help Jones execute a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world;
  • Gain a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.



OUR CULTURE

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their roles and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward.


Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • We give help generously
  • We fall in love with customer problems
  • We feel the pain, then we fix the process

  • We take care of ourselves with rest, time away from work and simply having fun

Jones helps real estate and construction firms to remove the barrier of insurance compliance through one software application that integrates with core operating systems. We envision a world where every property and construction site is connected by a network of insurance data enabling individuals to find, check and verify compliance instantly. Over 1 billion square feet of real estate relies on Jones daily, including firms such as Empire State Realty, Tishman Speyer, JLL, Rudin Management, and many more.


We have headquarters in New York, NY, and Tel Aviv, Israel. Our team spans 16 countries. Brazil's crew is expanding fast, fully remote, with annual in-person gatherings.
